historical_test_exposure: r4 test scores were inspected before this repair; this is not a blind test experiment
mft: zero instance inputs before Linear/LN, deactivate masked-source decoder attention; sum three focal losses

vcoco_adapter.channels: 25 action-role channels including point plus 4 agent-only channels
vcoco_adapter.null_representation: one zero-feature virtual entity per image, paired separately with every detected human
vcoco_adapter.null_features: zero object DETR/context features before the shared pair projection; real human features retained
vcoco_adapter.null_parameters: no separate null head or learned null token
vcoco_adapter.supervision: original trainval labels; preserve null/agent-only positives and unknown people
vcoco_adapter.crop_policy: a cropped-away real object is ignored, never relabeled as originally absent
vcoco_adapter.matching: best human IoU >= 0.5, visible entity IoU >= 0.5 and noun match; original missing roles only supervise null candidates
vcoco_adapter.compatibility: visible positive trainval edges only; null/agent candidates do not use noun compatibility
vcoco_adapter.export: one record per detected person; highest-score candidate per action-role; zero box for null; full official vocabulary
vcoco_adapter.score: sigmoid times (human confidence * entity confidence)^2.8; virtual entity confidence is 1

retained_reconstruction_assumptions: PViC-published DETR-R50 V-COCO initialization; exact equivalence to author detector unknown
ICR uses full queries and input-multiplied K/V, independent scopes and levels, post-norm residuals
CLIP top three pre-ln_post patch features, full-image square resize to 336, per-level 1024-to-384 projection
eight attention heads, FFN width 1536, dropout 0.1, single-layer pair encoder
focal alpha 0.5/gamma 0.1 and matched-positive normalization are declared assumptions
two-node eight-GPU layout preserves batch16, but is not the paper four-GPU layout
training_gate: CPU real-pretrained qualification plus eight-rank forward/backward/resume qualification for the same sealed protocol
claim_gate: never label this adaptation an author-weight or faithful-author-code reproduction
